empirical_release_gate.rule: #81 remains an unfrozen preparation record while #15 is open. After #15 closes, #81 may be frozen; #82/#83 remain blocked until Agent 3 independently passes #88 against that frozen #81 record.

fixed_program_hypotheses.H1: A preregistered Kronos + PIT-indicator fusion materially improves the primary V1-comparable metric versus the strongest comparable V1 control and both component-only controls.
fixed_program_hypotheses.H2: Any claimed gain remains attributable under frozen Kronos-only, indicators-only, and predeclared information-family ablations.
fixed_program_hypotheses.H3: Any claimed gain survives preregistered uncertainty, significance, robustness, and regime/sensitivity checks without a post-hoc subset.
fixed_program_hypotheses.null: No robust incremental value; preserve the negative result and do not widen the same experiment to rescue it.

identity_mapping.data_vintage_id: resolve from final governed dataset authority; #78 stage.context.dataset.freeze_id is the comparability anchor and executable experiment datasets[].vintage stores the frozen vintage identity
identity_mapping.evidence_tier: executable candidate decision.evidence_mode plus final governed dataset authority

required.resolution_rule: Inherit required metric identities, directionality, and zero-tolerance materiality directly from the landed #78 comparison policy; do not introduce V2-local substitutes.

optional.resolution_rule: Inherit optional longitudinal diagnostics from #78; absence does not replace the required metric gate.

primary_v1_control.selection_rule: At #81 freeze, bind the strongest #78-defined V1 stage comparable under every required hard-context identity. Current landed authority identifies Phase D as the V1-comparable control candidate; #15 closure is required before immutability is declared.

release_state.reason: #78 authority is resolved, but #15 is open and #81 is intentionally not frozen. No empirical child is released.

resolved_authoritative_values.target_timestamp_semantics: next-session selected-contract within-contract settlement log return; cross-contract returns prohibited

scope: Agent 2 / #81 preparation only. No V2 empirical execution, model fitting, prediction generation, new data acquisition, feature execution, tuning, results-driven design, freeze, or activation while #15 remains open.

stop_failure_criteria.condition: #15 is not closed/reconciled; preparation may continue, but #81 freeze/activation and all empirical child release remain blocked.
the landed #78 required metric set, directionality, or materiality policy cannot be resolved from the governed ledger
the planned V1 control cannot be mapped to a #78 stage with complete hard-context identity before #81 freeze
a #78 hard-context field changes without an explicit non-comparable declaration and separate experiment identity
PIT cutoff or leakage guard is unresolved for any executable candidate
seed, thresholds, uncertainty/multiplicity, artifact identity, or cost cap remains mutable/unresolved
a negative result would trigger post-hoc feature/model/hyperparameter/horizon search inside the same experiment
the finalized candidate records have not passed independent #88 statistical/model/reproducibility review
#84 later fails its preregistered material-increment gate against any required comparator
